---
title: "Mickaël CANOUIL<span class=\"title-suffix\">, Ph.D.</span>"
subtitle: Biostatistician, Quarto wizard, and cinephile.
image: /assets/images/social-profile.png
image-alt: "Profile picture of Mickaël CANOUIL"
body-classes: home-page
metadata-files:
  - _about.yml
format:
  mickaelcanouilfr-html:
    grid:
      body-width: 800px
    # Quarto's own obfuscation HTML-escapes the whole anchor and would print
    # the `iconify-icon` tag of the mailto buttons as literal text.
    # `filters/email-obfuscation.lua` covers the document links instead, and
    # the `about` block carries its own encoded href.
    email-obfuscation: none
about:
  # Only the home button: the rest of the row, and every other `about` key,
  # comes from `_about.yml`, which this page shares with `index.qmd`. Quarto
  # concatenates the two `links` lists with the document's entry first, so the
  # button opens the row. `id` and `template` are repeated because front
  # matter is validated before the merge, and a bare `links` key is rejected
  # as an `about` block with no template.
  id: edu-exp
  template: solana
  links:
    - text: '{{< iconify octicon:home-fill-16 title="mickael.canouil.fr" label="mickael.canouil.fr" >}}'
      href: "https://mickael.canouil.fr/"
      target: "_blank"
      rel: "noopener noreferrer"
      aria-label: "home logo for personal website"
---

Composition for the GitHub profile landing page at https://m.canouil.dev.
`mcanouil/mcanouil.github.io` copies this file to `index.qmd`, alongside
`_includes/`, and renders it as a single-page site, so it carries no listings
and every cross-page link is absolute. The leading underscore keeps Quarto from
rendering it as part of mickael.canouil.fr.
-->
